title: Who is speaking
summary: Every voice in the story has a face and a colour.
text:
The story has a cast. When someone speaks on a card, their **portrait**, name and role show at the top, and the card's edge takes their colour, so you can tell at a glance who is talking: your own colonists, people from other colonies, or things that are not people at all.

Radio messages show a smaller portrait in their corner panel.

A card with no portrait is the colony's own log: what happened, told as **we** for the colony and **you** for you.
